card.name: Stopping rules in hepatitis C treatment
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verbs such as achieve, on, at, for, by and until inside rules for stopping or continuing therapy. Seen mostly in hepatitis C antiviral dosing text, where a response target or time point comes next.

modes.label: Verb before a response target
modes.description: The word achieve after fail to or do not, before a viral-load goal.
modes.example: Re-treated patients who fail to<< achieve>> undetectable HCV-RNA at

modes.label: Linking word before a time point or basis
modes.description: Words like on, at, by or for that lead into a week, a response level or a stop condition.
modes.example: Refer to the prescribing information for specific HCV antiviral drugs used in combination with PEGASYS for information on stopping therapy based<< on>> treatment response.

card.writes: No clear link to the listed tokens, though some promoted ones relate to the word criteria.
card.plain: It marks the small words in rules that say when to stop or continue treatment based on how the patient responds.
